identities.contract: user-approved stabilization closure at collector request ownership

review.scope: plan ownership lifecycle dependency and proof route

source_edits.scope: local production code and regression tests

repository_discipline.rationale: The composition root selects the lifecycle; runner owns process retirement; FADA artifact owner seals cold identity.

dimensions.name: responsibility-ownership
dimensions.evidence: Async runner remains the unique process lifecycle owner and FADA source artifact remains the persistence owner.

dimensions.name: public-interface
dimensions.evidence: One explicit persistent or request lifecycle selector preserves the existing DAgger interface.

dimensions.name: dependency-direction
dimensions.evidence: FADA chooses lifecycle at its composition root; learner and collection code do not traverse process internals.

dimensions.name: state-lifecycle
dimensions.evidence: Request scope requires cooperative shutdown, join, exit inspection, process close, and error-pipe retirement before reuse.

dimensions.name: change-surface
dimensions.evidence: The plan reuses existing runner, shared-weight, artifact, and workflow boundaries without a parallel protocol.

dimensions.name: evidence-boundary
dimensions.evidence: Offline proof fixes the owner-boundary class; native-writer identity and remote recurrence remain unclaimed.

dimensions.name: proof-route
dimensions.evidence: RED request-lifecycle case, cleanup negative case, stale-artifact rejection, affected suites, and static checks are bounded.

dimensions.name: tensor-provenance
dimensions.evidence: Cold artifacts remain CPU-owned and no tensor shape dtype role mask or input changes.

dimensions.name: gradient-update-boundary
dimensions.evidence: Shared weight versions and learner update ordering are unchanged.

dimensions.name: persistence-evaluation
dimensions.evidence: Atomic artifacts gain request identity and fail before replay mutation on mismatch.

residual_risks.description: Offline lifecycle tests cannot prove the remote native failure will not recur inside one request.
residual_risks.disposition: Allow one bounded official transaction after code synchronization; do not reopen ordinary probing.
